The query finds that **0 distinct tools** were called by `pr-reviewer` runs created before October 28 2026.

```json
{
  "question": "How many distinct tools were called by pr-reviewer runs created before October 28, 2026?",
  "sql": "SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT tc.tool_name) AS distinct_tools\nFROM runs r\nJOIN tool_calls tc ON tc.run_id = r.id\nWHERE r.created_at < '2026-10-28'::date\n  AND r.metadata->>'agent' = 'pr-reviewer';",
  "row_count": 1,
  "answer": "0 distinct tools were called by pr-reviewer runs created before October 28, 2026."
}
```
